prompts.name: Plan Prompt
prompts.purpose: Analyze without implementing; select skills and define scope, assumptions, risks, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and executor-ready guidance.

prompts.name: Specify Prompt
prompts.purpose: Create structured functional and non-functional requirements with exclusions, dependencies, and testable acceptance criteria.

prompts.name: Design Prompt
prompts.purpose: Define architecture, data flow, components, interfaces, security, risks, alternatives, testing, deployment, and rollback.

prompts.name: Execute Prompt
prompts.purpose: Read approved requirements, design, tasks, and handoff; implement only approved scope; validate and report the diff without committing.

prompts.name: Debug Prompt
prompts.purpose: Reproduce with evidence, identify root cause, make the smallest safe authorized fix, and add regression validation.

prompts.name: Review Prompt
prompts.purpose: Compare the Git diff to requirements, design, tasks, and handoff; return APPROVED, APPROVED WITH CHANGES, or REJECTED with evidence.

prompts.name: Qa Prompt
prompts.purpose: Build and execute a traceable validation plan; record evidence, results, and unresolved failures.

prompts.name: Research Prompt
prompts.purpose: Define scope, gather sources, distinguish fact/inference/assumption/conflict/limitation, and protect confidential context.

prompts.name: Document Prompt
prompts.purpose: Create audience-appropriate user, administrator, developer, or executive documentation using communication skills.

prompts.name: Deploy Prompt
prompts.purpose: Assess readiness; require human approval; document configuration, smoke tests, monitoring, rollback; never deploy automatically.

prompts.name: Create Skill Prompt
prompts.purpose: Inspect skills, avoid duplication, create metadata and docs, update registries, validate, and do not commit.
